assessment.security_status_en: The United States is facing a period of heightened tension driven by the approaching midterm elections, high costs of living, and ongoing geopolitical conflicts, including escalating costs for the Iran war. The domestic scene is further marked by legal disputes, such as the challenge to a federal prosecutor's status in California and a grand jury's rejection of an indictment against Cassidy Hutchinson.

president_comments.statement_cs: Prezident Trump žertoval, že navrhované platby ve výši 5 000 dolarů pro dospělé Američany by stačily sotva na 'hamburger a možná malý dezert' v Mar-a-Lago vzhledem k rostoucím životním nákladům.

president_comments.statement_en: The president cast doubt on the security of the midterm elections, asserting that voter fraud is rampant.

articles.title: Obama v Trump – podcast
articles.summary:
In this episode of Guardian Australia’s US politics podcast, co-hosts Reged Ahmad and Jonathan Yerushalmy talk about Barack Obama’s war of words with Donald Trump, after the former president spoke at a campaign rally in Ohio and compared Trump’s White House changes to the Cheesecake Factory. But how effective is Obama on the Democratic party campaign trail? What are the risks around personal attacks? And how much does Obama’s legacy help or hinder when it comes to the midterms?

Reged and Jonathan also look at the backlash over an attack ad from the campaign of Republican nominee for governor of Ohio, Vivek Ramaswamy, and why some are saying it’s a new low for US politics. Finally, how has the perception of corruption in government become such a key issue for voters on both sides of the aisle?

articles.title: Trump says government to ‘terminate’ Biden-era methane emissions rules
articles.summary:
Critics warn of climate danger as president in Texas claims change will save companies and consumers billions

Donald Trump announced his administration is “terminating” Biden-era regulations holding oil and gas companies accountable for large leaks of planet-warming methane during a rally in Lubbock, Texas, on Tuesday evening.

Trump said during a campaign rally in Texas that the change would save consumers and energy producers $45bn and unlock 210 million barrels of oil – equivalent to about 10 days of US petroleum consumption. “Tonight, I’m officially terminating Biden’s expensive and unnecessary methane regulations to save consumers and energy producers,” Trump said, lifting what he called “crippling regulations on methane that caused prices to skyrocket” for small oil and gas operators.
